questions: Where exactly are the swollen lymph nodes (e.g., neck/cervical, armpit/axillary, groin/inguinal), and on which side?
How long have the swollen/painful lymph nodes been present (days vs weeks vs months)?
Do you have a fever or recent sore throat/upper-respiratory symptoms?
Do the painful swollen nodes have any redness or warmth of the overlying skin (yes/no)?
Do the swollen lymph nodes feel mobile under the skin or are they fixed/hard?
Do you have any dental pain, gum swelling, or recent tooth infection on the same side as the painful nodes?
Have you noticed any mouth sores, recent cold sores, or new genital sores or rash?
Have you noticed any weight loss, night sweats, or persistent fatigue?
Have you noticed any lump(s) in the armpit, neck, or groin that increase in size during the last few days, and are they tender to touch?
Have you noticed any recent skin injury, scratch, bite, or wound (including at the scalp, arm, or leg) on the same side of the swollen nodes?

No, I don’t notice redness or warmth on the skin over the swollen nodes.

No, I haven’t noticed any mouth sores, cold sores, or new genital sores or rash.
